mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, sender, content, attacker_action AS attackerAction, warning_explanation AS warningExplanation, steps, stage_details AS stageDetails, sms_email_report AS smsEmailReport FROM scenarios

SELECT id, type, title, sender, content, attacker_action AS attackerAction, warning_explanation AS warningExplanation, steps, stage_details AS stageDetails, sms_email_report AS smsEmailReport FROM scenarios WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenarios (id, type, title, sender, content, attacker_action, warning_explanation, steps, stage_details, sms_email_report, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{title}, #{sender}, #{content}, #{attackerAction}, #{warningExplanation}, #{steps}, #{stageDetails}, #{smsEmailReport}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = VALUES(type), title = VALUES(title), sender = VALUES(sender), content = VALUES(content), attacker_action = VALUES(attacker_action), warning_explanation = VALUES(warning_explanation), steps = VALUES(steps), stage_details = VALUES(stage_details), sms_email_report = VALUES(sms_email_report)
